who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent, lane proofs-1113; reported by the lanes realpark and reapproof (claude-opus-5-5)
where: crates/hir-ty-lean, the shape of emitted models, as met by the proofs of the real park (BlazeCore/Wait/ParkingLib.lean) and the reap
what: A proof about two threads names each thread`s program points, and the emitted model gives them no names: the park`s loop body after its wait, the retry step, its two swap exits and the unpark`s tail after its swap are inline subterms of `park.Shared_Still.loop_0` and `unpark.Shared`. The lane copied the model`s text into eight Lean definitions (`afterProg`, `swapDProg`, `unparkK`, ..) so its shape lemmas hold by `rfl`, and one copy first failed because the model`s `let _ <- if ..` elaborates to a join point inside a bind. Also: one loop emitted twice (`loop_0`, `loop_1`, a copy per branch of a `match` before it); an early `return` lowered by copying the rest of the function into each arm (the reap`s `reaps`, twice its size); `{ self with f := .. }` over a `match` copying the match into every field.
cost: about a third of ParkingLib.lean (296 lines) is the copied continuations; the copies must be redone when the Rust changes
cause: the translator emits one definition per function and per loop; a continuation after a call is an anonymous lambda of a bind
whys: a concurrency proof speaks of `where the thread stands`, which is a continuation, and the model has no name for one
models were shaped for sequential proofs, where a function is used whole
duplicated tails come from structuring MIR`s control flow back into expressions without sharing
class: generated text whose structure a proof must refer to but cannot name
prevention: in a shared function, emit the continuation after each operation on shared memory (and each loop body) as its own definition over the live variables, named by its place (`park.Shared_Still.after_3`), with the function as their composition; emit a tail shared by several arms once, as a definition the arms call. Proofs then name points the translator keeps stable. Not built.
workaround: copy the continuation`s text into the proof`s library and show it equal by `rfl`
fix: by the lane xlpoints (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-11-14: in a shared function the code after each shared call is its own definition (`f.at_n`, in a loop `f.loop_k.at_n`, the loop passed in so the recursion stays structural), a tail several arms reach is one point, and a loop is emitted once. The fixture`s park-shaped pair is proved for every schedule naming those points, no model text copied (lean/BlazeModel/atomics/parks.lean, 279 lines against 380). blaze-core`s park proof is ported to the regenerated models next.
